description: Defines the NetworkQualityEstimator class and related observer interfaces for estimating network quality metrics such as RTT, throughput, and effective connection type within the Chromium project. Contains class declarations, method signatures, and internal data structures.

classes.name: NetworkQualityEstimator
classes.description: Provides network quality estimates (RTT, throughput, effective connection type) and manages observers and network metrics collection within Chromium.

classes.name: RTTObserver
classes.description: Interface for observing round trip time measurements.

methods.name: GetEffectiveConnectionType
methods.description: Returns the current effective connection type.

methods.name: AddEffectiveConnectionTypeObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer for effective connection type changes.

methods.name: RemoveEffectiveConnectionTypeObserver
methods.description: Unregisters an observer for effective connection type changes.

methods.name: GetHttpRTT
methods.description: Returns the current HTTP RTT estimate.

methods.name: GetTransportRTT
methods.description: Returns the current transport RTT estimate.

methods.name: GetDownstreamThroughputKbps
methods.description: Returns the current downstream throughput estimate.

methods.name: AddRTTAndThroughputEstimatesObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer for RTT and throughput estimates.

methods.name: RemoveRTTAndThroughputEstimatesObserver
methods.description: Unregisters an observer for RTT and throughput estimates.

methods.name: NotifyHeadersReceived
methods.description: Informs the estimator that response headers have been received for a request.

methods.name: NotifyBytesRead
methods.description: Informs the estimator that bytes have been read for a request.

methods.name: NotifyStartTransaction
methods.description: Informs the estimator that request headers are about to be sent.

methods.name: NotifyRequestCompleted
methods.description: Informs the estimator that a request has completed.

methods.name: NotifyURLRequestDestroyed
methods.description: Informs the estimator that a request is being destroyed.

methods.name: AddRTTObserver
methods.description: Adds an RTT measurement observer.

methods.name: RemoveRTTObserver
methods.description: Removes an RTT measurement observer.

methods.name: AddThroughputObserver
methods.description: Adds a throughput measurement observer.

methods.name: RemoveThroughputObserver
methods.description: Removes a throughput measurement observer.

methods.name: GetSocketPerformanceWatcherFactory
methods.description: Returns the socket performance watcher factory.

methods.name: SetUseLocalHostRequestsForTesting
methods.description: Configures whether localhost requests are used for testing.

methods.name: SetUseSmallResponsesForTesting
methods.description: Configures whether small responses are used for testing.

methods.name: DisableOfflineCheckForTesting
methods.description: Disables offline device checks for testing.

methods.name: ReportEffectiveConnectionTypeForTesting
methods.description: Overrides the effective connection type for testing.

methods.name: ReportRTTsAndThroughputForTesting
methods.description: Overrides RTT and throughput estimates for testing.

methods.name: OnConnectionTypeChanged
methods.description: Handles network connection type changes.

methods.name: GetRecentRTT
methods.description: Retrieves recent RTT measurements.

methods.name: GetRecentDownlinkThroughputKbps
methods.description: Retrieves recent throughput measurements.

methods.name: SetTickClockForTesting
methods.description: Overrides the tick clock for testing.

methods.name: GetRecentEffectiveConnectionTypeUsingMetrics
methods.description: Computes effective connection type based on recent metrics.

methods.name: OnUpdatedTransportRTTAvailable
methods.description: Handles new transport RTT data from socket watchers.

methods.name: GetRTTEstimateInternal
methods.description: Calculates RTT estimate at a given percentile.

methods.name: GetDownlinkThroughputKbpsEstimateInternal
methods.description: Calculates throughput estimate at a given percentile.

methods.name: NotifyObserversOfRTTOrThroughputComputed
methods.description: Notifies observers that RTT/throughput estimates are computed.

methods.name: NotifyRTTAndThroughputEstimatesObserverIfPresent
methods.description: Notifies a specific observer of current RTT/throughput.

methods.name: AddAndNotifyObserversOfRTT
methods.description: Adds RTT observation and notifies observers.

methods.name: AddAndNotifyObserversOfThroughput
methods.description: Adds throughput observation and notifies observers.

methods.name: IsHangingRequest
methods.description: Determines if a request is likely hanging based on RTT.

methods.name: ComputeEffectiveConnectionType
methods.description: Recomputes the effective connection type.

methods.name: GetOverrideECT
methods.description: Returns overridden effective connection type for testing.
